How many berths in all the classes together are vacant in Trains B and C
solution:
**Calculation:**

The berths in all the classes together are vacant in Trains B is 

⇒ 10 + 17+ 52 + 85 + 86 = 250

The berths in all the classes together are vacant in Trains C is 

⇒ 2 + 9+ 36+ 9 + 16 = 72

Total number of vacant berth 250 + 72 = 322

**∴ The correct option is 3**
